title: # Build: axhub-veto-pass (axHub repo) Requested by Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice).
asked: # Build: axhub-veto-pass (axHub repo) Requested by Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice). GO given. Build it now. ## What Brett wants When he talks to Claude and changes theme colours in the AmberX console, he doesn't want a veto countdown on every change. He says "allow theme changes for the next 30 minutes" and, for that window, matching calls run immediately. The AmberX-AXF side (build `theme-veto-pass`, token-control plugin, control@1 `pass` resource) is being built in parallel; this is axHub's half. ## Steps - s1 Timed policy passes in axHub's policy engine: a pass = {service, tool pattern(s) or scope, expiresAt, grantedBy, reason}. While active, calls matching it skip the veto/confirm hold and run at once ('ran under pass <id>' in the approvals log). Server-side expiry. Never covers tools annotated destructive/delete (those keep their policy). - s2 Granting a pass requires the owner: it's created only by an approved call (the grant itself goes through one veto/confirm that must be approved or allowed to run by Brett) or by Brett in the axHub web UI. A headless session/agent can't self-grant (same idea as decision 109 X-Axhub-Session + the model-upgrade-approval rule). - s3 Built-in tool `axhub.pass_grant {service, scope|tools, minutes, reason}`, `axhub.pass_status`, `axhub.pass_revoke`; and honour passes published by the AmberX console's token-control plugin (`GET /api/plugins/token-control/pass`, scope stamps on calls) per the contract written by the AmberX-side build (coordinate: put the contract in docs/ and match it). - s4 Read-only tools: tools annotated readOnly on any service run without veto when the service policy is the recommended default (reads allow, writes veto, deletes confirm); add that as a policy preset and apply it to the console services (`axf-console`, token-control) when they're registered. - s5 axHub web: active passes with countdown, revoke/extend, and the approvals log filter 'ran under pass'. - s6 Tests, docs, decision log entry, CLAUDE.md status, PR. Code, comments and commits clean and professional. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once.

steps.text: s1 timed passes in core policy (PassBook, storage, migration 6)
s2+s3 owner-only grant + axhub.pass_* tools + console feed
s5 AXHub web Passes screen (AXF apps/axhub-web)

result.summary: Timed policy passes (pass@1), owner-only axhub.pass_grant (ownerGrant), pass_status/revoke, console pass feed (control-pass@1), recommended preset, web API + AXHub web Passes screen, 'ran under pass' log filter; decision #112
